div.div:
Legend
━━▶ Call (the response takes the same path back)
╍╍▶ Static file delivery
━━▶ CI flow
┈┈▶ Call log (the “SDK calls” panel)
Colors: blue main thread, orange Service Worker, purple Web Worker
Only the static files come over the network. Every call to DynamoDB, S3 and SQS stays inside the tab.

div.div:
By the numbers
• wasm: about 27 MB; GitHub Pages sends about 9 MB with gzip
• Start-up makes 13 SDK calls (table, bucket, queue, 3 seed todos, then the first list and change log)
• Adding a todo makes 6 SDK calls:
PutItem, SendMessage (the change)
Scan (reload the list)
ReceiveMessage, DeleteMessageBatch, ReceiveMessage (drain the change log)
• DescribeTable right after CreateTable skips the 3-second CREATING state on the virtual clock

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 628px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #171717;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #171717; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
What happens when you add a todo
1. React fetches POST api/todos
2. The Service Worker intercepts it and passes it to MSW in the page
3. The MSW handler calls the Hono app: app.fetch(request)
4. api/todos.js sends PutItem (DynamoDB) and SendMessage (SQS) with the SDK
5. The SDK serializes and signs the request and hands it to WasmRequestHandler
6. createEmulator packs it into a frame and transfers it to the Worker
7. worker.mjs calls the C ABI (emu_handle); the router in the wasm dispatches it
8. The response frame goes back the same way and becomes the fetch Response
9. The page reloads the list (GET api/todos) and the change log (GET api/activity)
10. Finally, GET api/emulator returns the call count and the call log
